decisions.decision: Do not wait on Bharath; build now and give him one review. (1) Read `memory/lead-intake-feature-gap.md`, then check the effort 2 estimate against the campaign code in the local clone `~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2`. Keep the `seed.py` inputs unless the code contradicts them. If you change any, re-run `weekly.py` and stop if FR-ad7abb no longer scores build now. (2) On a local-only branch of that clone (branch `development`, never pushed), build the endpoint that adds a lead to a running campaign: enroll one contact into an active campaign without unlocking `contactListIds`, idempotent on repeat, scope-guarded, with a passing regression test. (3) Save the patch and a short spec under `workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/`. The spec lists the four inputs for Bharath to confirm or correct, alongside test output. (4) Commit, push, sync the board, and set T-396 to review for Bharath. Add the `releases.json` entry only after it ships.
